name: Taco Beef, Potato, Zucchini & Bell Pepper Bake with Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
3 yellow bell peppers
1.02 kg new potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and medium dice onions; divide between two baking sheet pans.
Trim and medium dice zucchini; trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add both to the baking sheets with the onion.
Quarter potatoes and add to the baking sheets. Drizzle veggies with oil and sprinkle with taco seasoning; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup taco seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are tender about 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add beef and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until almost cooked through, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
¼ cup taco seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add water to the skillet with the beef; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened and beef is cooked through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
To serve, divide roasted veggies between plates or bowls; top with beef and a dollop yogurt. Enjoy!
